reason: A DeepSeek Harness enhancement plugin primarily focused on interface translation, chat layout, thinking-display controls, conversation navigation, archiving, and optional prompt injection.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供中文界面补全、聊天布局与思考展示控制，以及会话归档和删除等界面增强功能。
summaries.en: Enhances DeepSeek Harness with Chinese interface completion, chat layout and thinking-display controls, plus conversation archiving and deletion features.

capabilities: modifies the DeepSeek Harness web interface and layout
stores plugin settings in browser localStorage and DSH settings.yaml
moves deleted conversation logs to the operating system trash
optionally injects user-configured prompts into subsequent model requests
